quote: ClinRaGen, a multimodal framework that transfers LLM reasoning capabilities into SLMs for disease diagnosis and clinical rationale generation.
ClinRaGen can produce both medical note-based rationales ... and lab test-based rationales ... enabling SLMs to generate disease diagnoses and structured clinical multimodal rationales.
We propose ClinRaGen, a multimodal framework that transfers LLM reasoning capabilities into SLMs for disease diagnosis and clinical rationale generation, achieving both accuracy and interpretability.
outputs: Generated clinical rationales for disease diagnosis, including medical note-based rationales and lab test-based rationales.
textual clinical rationales and disease diagnosis predictions

ClinRaGen generates two types of rationales: medical note-based rationales (R m ) and lab test-based rationales (R t ) from medical notes (M ), time-series lab test results (T ), and disease-specific knowledge (K).
